verdict.rationale: monday.com's apps framework documents building custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets and full-page apps. Its open-source Vibe React components let these apps look native to the product. The community complaints about slowness and the UI are about the core product, not app building, so they do not affect this story. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation on the view/widget SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom views and widgets actually feel native.
